Coreweave initially loaded up on GPUs to mine Ethereum, made money off that during the boom, then pivoted to being a GPU cloud, and found themselves with all these GPUs in the ML/AI bubble. Amazing run.

From CoreWeave's S-1: 'For the years ended December 31, 2023 and 2024, our largest customer was Microsoft, which accounted for 35% and 62% of our revenue, respectively.' A commenter noted surprise at how dependent CoreWeave is on a single customer.
In its third quarter earnings, CoreWeave reported $51.9 million in operating income — and $310 million in interest expense, prompting a commenter to react with 'Holy cow' at the debt burden.

Discussion noted CoreWeave uses SPVs (special purpose vehicles) for financing that 'aren't subject to the same kinds of regulations as the parent company,' raising questions about transparency of its debt structure.

A job candidate described CoreWeave's interview process: 'CoreWeave feels very YC-ish... interviewed by someone who knew a lot of my peers... asked very textbook style questions... I interviewed with them three times for two different roles.'
